research.facts:
Texas Tech 2027 Coaching Staff Overhaul
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence — multiple sources):**
- Texas Tech will NOT renew assistant coaches Hunter Veach and Kayla Kowalik — confirmed by SI/On SI (Softball) reporting
- New hires: Jeff Cottrill and Shelby Pendley (joining returning assistant Tara Archibald)
- Head coach Gerry Glasco enters Year 3 at Texas Tech; record of 41-7 in Big 12 through first 2 years
- Texas Tech held the No. 1 transfer portal class in the country this offseason
- Texas Tech lost 2026 WCWS finals to Texas (Mike White, 2nd championship)
- Texas Tech lost 2026 Big 12 Tournament championship to Arizona State
- Wikipedia: Wikipedia 2026 Texas Tech Red Raiders softball team confirms Veach listed as second-season assistant
research.sources: - Sources: SI/On SI, texastech.com, Yahoo Sports

research.facts:
NCAA Names Marty Abezetian Softball Officiating Director
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence — NCAA official announcement):**
- Title: NCAA Director of Training and Video Review, Softball
- Announcement date: October 5, 2026 (per NCAA.org)
- Experience: 17 seasons as collegiate softball umpire, including WCWS in 2025
- Returning to role he helped create: previously served 6 years as softball video services coordinator, then 2 years as first director of training and video review
- Goal: umpire development, consistency, video review quality
